fieldNotes: id: <group>.<box>; the box number also determines the column (value letter A-F); G/H/I sit in column F.
twists: number of full turns (0.5 = 1/2 turn).
saltos: number of saltos (1.5 = one and a half).
direction: salto direction for saltos; circling direction for swing and in-bar elements; 'none' for non-salto flights and hechts.
shape: tuck | pike | straight | straddle | none.
handstandCategory: strict | lenient | none (selects the handstand deviation table in deductions.json).
variants: same id and value as the base element, written out in full.
family: special repetition group; families[].maxPerExercise is the limit per family. Empty = no family.
needsReview: value derived by us or still open; reviewNote says why.
